correctness.rationale: The defining plane cubic is birational to binary quartic w²=(A+tB)(A(x²+y²)+tB(x²-xy+y²)), A=x-ay and B=x-y. Recomputing invariant I,J yields Δ∝(a-1)²t²(t+1)²(t+a)²Q_a(t) with deg(Q)=4; independently factored Q discriminant 512(a-1)^4(a²-a+1)(71a²-196a+71)^3 and evaluated I,J,Q local orders at all seven exceptional parameter loci. The Tate–Kodaira characteristic-zero table, including additive III (1,2,3) and II (1,1,2), determines fiber types. The discriminant at infinity contributes order 2, total Euler 12. Resolving nine basepoints counting the infinitely near one at a²-a+1=0 produces a relatively minimal rational elliptic surface with section, and Shioda–Tate rank = 8−sum(m_v−1) yields the five listed ranks. A separate exact SymPy calculation matched all exceptional valuations and generic factorization.
